claims.preconditions: Claimant holds unlocked tokens; unexpired ClaimData voucher signed by claimant and platform
claims.expected_result: Second submission of identical ClaimData reverts SignatureAlreadyConsumed
claims.observed_result: Both submissions execute successfully without revert; digest is not tracked
claims.interpretation: Replay condition is real and deterministic; contract lacks digest nullification
claims.limitations: Replay window is bounded by block.timestamp < expiresAt

claims.preconditions: Investor in SPV across tranches where market price increases; unexpired earlier low-price voucher
claims.expected_result: Carry fee is deducted based on current fair market token price (68 tokens at $10)
claims.observed_result: Carry fee evaluated at historical $1 price, computing 0 carry fee (68 tokens stolen)
claims.interpretation: 100% carry evasion achieved via stale valuation replay, causing direct loss to deal leads
claims.limitations: Requires price appreciation prior to voucher expiration

claims.preconditions: Deal lead signs partial carry withdrawal; accrued carry exceeds voucher amount
claims.expected_result: Cumulative withdrawals cannot exceed single signed voucher authorization
claims.observed_result: Voucher replayed 3x, draining 150 tokens from pool instead of 50 tokens authorized
claims.interpretation: Permissionless function allows unauthorized involuntary liquidation of carry pool
claims.limitations: Drained tokens are transferred to deal lead receiver address, causing tax/cash-flow griefing rather than direct third-party theft

claims.preconditions: Claimant attempts to claim beyond total SPV distribution shares
claims.expected_result: Claims exceeding distribution shares revert AmountExceedsClaimable
claims.observed_result: Reverts AmountExceedsClaimable as expected; investor principal cannot be stolen
claims.interpretation: Exploit cannot drain innocent investors' principal; theft is strictly bounded to performance fees

claims.interpretation: Fix is safe, effective, and backwards-compatible with deployed proxies
